tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med pa lha dgu'i sgrub pa'i thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra nā tha dharma swā mi gu ru ā yur+dzñā na a pa ri mi ta ye na mo/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo'i mgon po chos kyi rje bla ma tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i bla ma dang / /tshe dang ye shes dpag med la btud nas/ /tshe dpal bsod nams rab tu rgyas pa'i phyir/ /tshe 'phel cho ga 'chi med dpal ster bri/ /bsod nams mtha' yas ldan pa'i skye bo rnams/ /bsod nams chen po'i don gnyis lhun grub phyir/ /bsod nams tshe dang ye shes 'phel ba'i thabs/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i blang bya 'di longs shig /ye shes tshe 'dir 'char bar 'dod pa rnams/ /ye shes dpag med cho gas tshe bsrings nas/ /ye shes skye ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad na/ /ye shes myur du 'char bar 'gyur ro kye/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang spro ba bskyed pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir gang zag dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dag gis rang gzhan gyi don du rgyud rnams kyi rtsa ba bya rgyud kyi pad+ma'i rigs kyi nang tshan/ mtshan brgya'i gzungs kyi cho ga slob dpon dze tā ri'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig mdo rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la dben zhing dga' ba'i gnas su ras la sogs pa'i gzhi gtsang ma'i steng / nas sogs kyi 'bru bkram pa'i steng du tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs par bkram pa'i mtha' bskor gyi byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/

lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri mchog byang du zhal zas rnams dkyil 'khor dang bstun pa'i phyogs mtshams su khor mor bkod/ byang shar nas brtsams te shar phyogs mchod pa'i stegs lta bur tshe dpag med kyi gtor ma gcig dang / cha gsum gtor ma rnams bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa dgu'am/ bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis chu gtsang mas bkrus/ kha nas gu gul gyis bdugs/ 'gab nas yungs dkar gtor zhing / sum+bha ni slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rjes brjod la bgegs bsal/ mgul chings dang ldan pa/ bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad re'i steng du dri bzang gi chus gsum gnyis man khengs pa/ 'byor na bum rdzas thun mong nyer lnga yang btab/ ku sha'i kha rgyan can rnam rgyal gyi steng du dri zhim po'i chus bkang ba'i dung chos/ rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bzhag rdo dril/ 'thor nas/ maṇ+ḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par bsham pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed bsgom pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa/ dbang blang ba dang gsum las/ dang po la thog mar mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas shing / oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai pi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dang rol mo byas te byin dbab/ de nas skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la sogs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu la sangs rgyas byang sems 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas spyan drangs la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis phyag bya/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai pi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje ra nyi shu pa shar sngo lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ lan gsum/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyangs pa/

de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang / pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur por gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i go 'phang la bkod/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs dang tshe'i dngos grub 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byung nas hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bdag nyid sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar du kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lhor yon tan tshe dpag med/ lho nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i thugs kha'i stod du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas tshe dpag med lha dgu la sangs rgyas byang sems 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pa re res dbur brgyan/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥyig gi mtha' bskor du sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas bskor du bskor ba las 'od dmar po 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las ngan gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad tshe'i dngos grub dang /

sngags phreng rnams 'od dmar po'i rnam par byung nas rang gi lus kyi nang gang bas tshe dang bsod nams ye shes la sogs pa rgyas par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ oṃ na mo bh+rum̐ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ.ā ro lik hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes snying po dang / oṃ tad+ya thā a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥhūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swāhā/ zhes yang snying ming gi snying po dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na/ su bi nish+tsi te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya arā ha te/ samyak+sam̐ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye dzñā na sam̐ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṅkā ra pa ri shud+dha/ dharmā te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa bha wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā ri swāhā/ rtsa sngags gzungs ring rnams ci nus bzlas la/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta sogs nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i bar gong bzhin gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod de brtan par bya/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ de rang gtso bo la thim/ rang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dam ye dbyer med kyi nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa la/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa/

bum bskyed bya ba/ gtor ma btang ba rnams so/ /bsgrub cing mchod pa ni/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje ra nyi shu pa shar sngo zhes pa nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ ces pa'i bar dang / de'i dbus sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / zhes pa nas/ dbus dkar ba'i zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed la/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po rang cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ ces pa nas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i stod du zla ba la gnas pa'i yi ge hrīḥdamar po/ /zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar brjod cing / dam tshig pa bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ hrī yig dmar po de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sarkā ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas bcas pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yi ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma kā ma la ya satwam̐/ zhes gdan dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hrīḥyig las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pa re res dbur brgyan/ de nas brtan byed bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang du bsgrub bya bsam nas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam zhing / gzungs ring brgya rtsa sogs ci mang bzlas la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ 'on kyang dharmā ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gis dbang thob pa'i bla ma dang gnyis su med par bsams te de la mchod pa'i bsam pas/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /mgon po tshe dpag med la 'bul/ /tshe dang ye shes stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

zhes pa dang / pad bskor sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /zhes dang / pā d+yaṃ/ bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dhū paṃ/ snang gsal ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /ā lo ke me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /push+paṃ/ dri mchog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /gan+dhaṃ/ zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /nai wid+yaṃ/ rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /zhes dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur la/ mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs dang rol mo bya/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs rgyal srid sna bdun dang / kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /zhes sogs 'dod yon lnga rnams kun rig bzhin phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs kun/ /ma lus par ni sel mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung zhing / /nyes pa'i dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje'i lus can rdo rje can/ /rdo rje tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /bsam pa'i don kun skad cig gis/ /rang 'dod bzhin du tshim mdzad dpal/ /mchog gi bdag po chen po ste/ /rin chen༞ ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis/ /kun nas gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /thugs rje'i chags tshul ston mdzad pa'i/ /pad+ma tshe༞ 'dod pa'i las rnams ma lus pa/ /skad cig nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /bsam kun 'phel byed dpag bsam shing / /las kyi tshe༞ nyes pa kun las khyod grol nas/ /sna tshogs yon tan kun gyis brgyan/ /'khor ba'i skyabs mdzad dpa' bo ste/ /kun gzigs tshe༞ stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te/

/mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus 'joms/ /ston pa sred med bu yi stobs/ /yon tan tshe༞ me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa'i/ /ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rtog pa ma lus khyod kyis spangs/ /ye shes tshe༞ rnam par rtogs las khyod grol nas/ /mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba ste/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /mi g.yo tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung / /khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la/ /tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ de yan gyis mdun bskyed bsgrub pa bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bum bskyed ni/ bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i gdan rnams kyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po re re/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ ces pa nas/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ las thams cad pa'i bum par hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ cung zad khro ba'i nyams can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med lha dgu bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi/ sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang skur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ lha dgu la 'od dpag tu med pa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta a yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin thog mtha' gnyis kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wid+yaṃ/ shap+ta'i bar rigs 'gre sbyar la rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /sogs lha dgu'i bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces sogs kyis bstod/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar bsam la/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang /

sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing lag gnyis pad bskor dang bcas pas gzungs thag bzung ste rnam rgyal la rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying nyer gcig la sogs pa gang mang bzla/ las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus bzlas nas gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blug ste/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ de rnams kyis bum bskyed bstan zin nas/ gsum pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das kyi gzungs ring la/ a kā ro btags la lan gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas phul/ ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar spyi 'gre/ bcom ldan 'das mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsol zhing / tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ phyogs skyong dang / 'byung po'i gtor ma byin gyis rlabs nas brtsams te bgegs gtor gyi bar cha gsum gtor ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa bzhin la/ 'on kyang bden brdar gyi skabs su/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs gzhung bzhin sbyar ro/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes/ lha bum gyi chu la las bum gyi chu blugs la dpon slob rnams kyi dung chos su phul grub pa dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas la/ rgyas par byed na/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god bar lan gsum gyi rigs lnga sdom bzung byas kyang rung gsungs/ bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi dbang bskur thob pa'i bla ma dang tha mi dad du bsams la/ bum chu 'thung zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i 'khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso bo tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang /

bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dga' chen khyed bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis rgyun bshags/ gdong bcing ba'i tshul bya zhing / oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma nā ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcings par bsam/ lag tu me tog bzung zhing / ā kham̐ṃwī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod par me tog gnang bar bsam/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur/ ces brjod cing las bum gyi chu ku shas rang la gtor/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dang / skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes pas dris lan dang po dang / de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dang / sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes pas dris lan gnyis pa byas par bsam/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud pa da yā mi/ zhes dang snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra te sa ma yasatwāṃ ho sid+dha badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdams pa ni rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyis/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du 'khrid par mos nas/

dkyil 'khor la mgo dud pa dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag btsal bar mos te/ thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ na mo ste hūm̐/ de bzhin du mgrin par sbyar la/ na mā mi hūm̐/ de bzhin du snying khar bcas la/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs kyis dbul/ thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig bdag la 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rang gi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang skad cig gis hrīḥyig las mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / dbu skra ral ba'i thor cog can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du zla ba la gnas pa'i yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka dang / rang gi snying ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ rang la sngon chad nyon mongs pa dang nad dang /

mya ngan drag pos gdung ba dang / mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i dus su tshe dang bsod nams thams cad mi ma yin sde brgyad kyi lag tu shor zhing nyams pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug ste 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam pas rang gi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu kha nas sib sib thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang ste/ tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad sor tshud/ slar tshe dang bsod nams thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ ces dang / rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil/ snying po nye snying / gzungs ring rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes mang du brjod/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka dang / rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ phyi rol na 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ mi bsod nams chen po rnams dang / khams kyi rgyal phran dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dang / bcud kyi sems can dang / tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang bram ze'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phog pas de rnams la yod pa'i tshe 'dzin pa'i rig pa dang / tshe'i ro bcud dang / byin rlabs thams cad 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i ba spu'i bu kha rnams nas sib sib thim pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub par gyur/ ces dang dril gsil sngags sogs gong bzhin brjod/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka dang / rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam/

sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs rje mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi sku rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi tshogs kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa khyad par du dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi nas/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / khyad par dbang gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ ces dang / dril gsil sngags rnams gong bzhin/ de nas rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag cing / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pa'i tshe dngos grub brtan par bsam/ rang gis me tog dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul bar bsam la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas me tog dkyil 'khor la phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gnang bar bsams la/ me tog cung zad rang gi mgor bzhag cing / pra ti gṛh+ṇa mi mam̐ sa satwa ma hā ba la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ a he badz+ra pa sh+ya /zhes brjod cing mig ras phye ba'i tshul bya/ thar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad sku dang tsa ka li lta bu ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal lam ste mthong ba yin no/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi la thog mar/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla sogs kyis/ dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs spyi dang 'dra ba lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs dkyil 'khor dkar dmar nag pa'i ra ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo gcig pa'i nang du rin po che khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po zhes pa nas/ sku can zhes pa'i bar nang 'jug gi tshe dngos grub zhu ba'i skabs ltar bskyed/ sku can du gyur pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang sems tshogs kyis bskor ba pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lha mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo dang bcas pa bum pa rnams kyis rim gyis dbang bskur bar bsam la/ dbus kyi bum pa spyi bor bzhag par bsam zhing / rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing / lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phos nas/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes dang gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod/ bum chu 'thung / dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi yi seng ge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs te/

/snying rje can gyis grong khyer 'jug pa na/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sgra ni grags par 'gyur/ /sbyin pa mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /de bzhin sbyin pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims dang / bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab/ bcug ste 'don pa bsgyur grub pa dang / de ltar dbang bskur zhing bkra shis kyi tshig brjod pa la brten nas skye ba snga ma rnams su nyon mongs pa gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te sems can gzhan gyi srog bcad pa la brten nas tshe 'dir tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyangs te/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ slar yang shar phyogs kyi bum pa thogs nas dpral bar bzhag par mos te/ rnam rgyal bum pa dpral bar bzhag la/ lus la rdo rje'i༞ bu khyod༞ bskal pa༞ srog gcod༞ oṃ badz+ra ā yur sogs dang bum chu 'thung / dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sogs phar phyin drug gi bkra shis brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur zhing bkra shis kyi tshig brjod pa la brten nas rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs ste sogs 'dra/ rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra/ slar yang lho phyogs kyi bum pa thogs par bsam zhing / rnam rgyal bum pa rna ltag g.yas su reg la/ lus la rin chen༞ sogs 'don pa spo ba 'dra/ oṃ rat+na ā yur sogs dang / sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sogs dang / dril gsil/ nyon mongs pa ser sna dang nga rgyal sogs/ rin chen tshe dpag tu med pa sogs gong gi rigs 'gre sbyar la shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du nub kyi bum pa thogs par bsam zhing / rnam rgyal bum pa ltag par reg la/ lus la pad+ma'i sogs dang / oṃ pad+ma ā yur sogs dang / bum chu 'thung / sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sogs kyi bkra shis/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sogs dang / pad+ma tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra/

de bzhin du byang gi bum pa thogs par bsam la/ rnam rgyal bum pa rna ltag g.yon du reg ste/ lus la las kyi sogs dang / oṃ karma ā yur sogs dang / sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sogs dang dril gsil bya/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog sogs dang / don grub tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra zhing / rigs lnga so so'i sngags thams cad kyi mjug tu gzungs ring tshar re brjod/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa rigs lngas dbur brgyan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos spyi bor bcings par bsam nas/ rang gi lag pa thal mo gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor gshibs/ sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgo thog tu bzhag la/ oṃ pad+mo bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas byab bkru bsrung gsum gyi/ dang po bkru ba ni/ rnam rgyal gyi chu dang / las bum gyi chu bsres pa cung zad 'thung zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos rang la khrus mdzad par bsam la/ rang gi gdong la ku shas bum chu gtor te/ de ltar na phyogs kyi bum pa'am/ rnam rgyal bum pa la brten nas dbang gi dngos gzhi thob nas/ mtshams kyi bum pa'am/ las kyi bum pa'i khrus bya ba'i don du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos las kyi bum pa'i chu rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chu dang bcas pas bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ khyad par dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad bkrus shing sbyangs par gyur/ ces dang / oṃ na mo bh+rum̐ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ.ā ro lik hūm̐ hrīḥzhes snying po dang / tad+yathā a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥhūm̐ bh+rum̐ swāhā/ yang snying ming gi snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/

zhes pa rnams cung zad bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du/ shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa kun la sbyar te/ nad thams cad༞ rims thams cad༞ gdon thams cad༞ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad༞ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad༞ 'khon dang grib dang 'bags pa dang mi gtsang ba thams cad༞ byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad༞ bkra mi shis pa thams cad༞ mtshan mo nag mo dang / dus kyi zhags pa dang / gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad༞ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad༞ rgyal po dang the rang gi gnod pa thams cad༞ btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad༞ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis bkrus par bsam la bum chus kha bshal bar mos pa tsam byed/ gnyis pa byab pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso bos mdzad par bsam la/ de nas byab pa'i don du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i phyag na rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rma bya'i sgro mdong gi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig ljang sngon/ des rang gi lus la bskor zhing byab pa la brten nas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ khyad par dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad bkrus pa'i lhag ma cung zad yod pa rnams rdo khab len gyis khab len pa'am/ shel sbur len gyis sbur len pa ltar tsen gyis blangs nas phyi'i rgya mtsho la dor bar gyur/ ces brjod/ oṃ na mo bh+rum̐ sogs gsum brjod/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ya swāhā/ de bzhin du/ nad thams cad a pa nā ya swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad a pa nā ya swāhā/ zhes shan+tiṃ ku ru dang / a pa na 'don pa bsgyur la bya'o/

/gsum pa bsrung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos mdzad par bsam la/ de nas bsrung ba'i don du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos phyag gi rdo rje rang gi lus kyi gnas rnams su gtugs pa la brten nas/ de dang der rdo rje dmar po re mtshal gyis par btab pa bzhin gsal lam ste byung bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ gong bzhin/ oṃ na mo bh+rum̐ sogs sngags gsum dang / gnas rnams su rdo rje rgya gram mdzad par mos la/ rang gi spyi bo dang mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram gtugs te/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥzhes pa nas/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad las rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥzhes pa'i bar/ a pa nā ya dang / rak+ṣaḥ'adon pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong bzhin tshang bar brjod cing / de ltar rang gi gnas rnams su rdo rje dmar po mtshal gyi par btab pa bzhin gsal lam byung ba de rnams las rdo rje dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa mched de lus kyi ba spu'i bu kha thams cad la rdo rje'i go bskon par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ yang gong du bshad pa'i rdo rje'i gtugs pa'i gnas bdun gyi steng du dpral ba dang mgrin pa gnyis bsnan pa'i gnas dgur gtugs pa'i phyag len yang snang ngo / /de nas dngos gzhi byin gyis rlabs pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gsungs par bsam la/ rang nyid mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i snying khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med de rigs lnga dang / spyi bo'i steng du yang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ye shes tshe dpag tu med pa ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku can du gsal lam ste bzhugs par gyur/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ bla ma yi dam/ khyad par mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ rnam pa 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag tu med pa spyan drangs rang gi spyi bo'i steng gi ye shes tshe dpag tu med pa la thim/ ye shes tshe dpag tu med pa la yang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du mer gyis zhu/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu kha nas zhugs te snying kha'i rigs lnga tshe dpag tu med pa la thim/ snying kha'i rigs lnga tshe dpag tu med pa yang 'od du mer zhu nas lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pas mer gyis gang ba la brten nas lus kyi gzungs dang / sems kyi rten du gnas par gyur/ ces dang / gtso bos mdzad par bsams te spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la snying po/ yang snying gzungs ring rnams tshar gsum ji ltar rigs pa skabs dang bstun nas brjod pa'i mthar/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu brnyas pa spang bar gyis/ /'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom pas/ /bu khyod tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /zhes brjod/ de nas mtha' brten shis par byed pa la thog mar rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyis shis pa brjod pa ni/ 'di skabs rin chen sna bdun gyi gzugs dngos su yod na oṃ na mo bh+rum̐ sogs snying pos byin gyis brlab/ med na phyag rgya dang bcas te/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bos rin chen sna bdun rim pa bzhin du rang la gtad par bsam la/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/

/rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ bdud thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas chos can gyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs par bskor nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas bai ḍūr+ya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing / /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan ji bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'od dang ldan zhing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad rang gi gzi brjid kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing gzugs bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ wasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin zhi ba'i tshul gyis bdag dang gzhan gyi don bde bar bsgrub pa la yid bzhin du 'byor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig gang yang rgyal ba mu tig dang ldan pa'i/ /gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ /blon po rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mā hā ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa thob ste/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan zhing ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ stobs bcu dang ldan zhing bdud bzhi'i stobs tshar bcad nas sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la 'jug nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig

tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus pa'i/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tu raṅga a sho rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhis 'gro ba rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su thogs pa med par skyel nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur ba'i/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste/ /dpa' brten 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag mi rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ khad+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dgos pa mthar phyin nas 'jigs tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms shing ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig de rnams kyis rgyal srid sna bdun gyis shis pa bya ba'i tshul bstan zin nas/ de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis shis pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bos mdzad par bsam la/ rdzas brgyad yid kyis bsgom pa la bum chu gtor bar mos te/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ maṅga laṃ aṣ+ṭa dra bya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa gsum bzla/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso bos bkra shis rdzas brgyad rim pa bzhin rang gi lag tu gtad par bsam la/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba la brten nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/

deng 'dir bdag dang sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu tshe ring zhing bkra shis par gyur cig bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yis/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu phul ba la brten nas sogs gong bzhin brjod/ dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba phyag tu phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs brjod/ gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa bsrung gis gi wang phyag tu phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs dang / zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rtogs gyur nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur ba yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs dang / yungs kar rdo rje rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs dang / li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/

/bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu phul ba la brten nas sogs dang / dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul ba la brten nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang bdag dang sems can thams cad dung dkar gyi rdzas la brten nas shin tu tshe ring zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /ces brjod dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang / lo brgya thub cing sogs skabs su gang babs kyi bkra shis kyi tshig brjod cing me tog gtor la bkra shis par bya'o/ /gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang / dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa phul te lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum brjod/ spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ gong bzhin byin rlabs bya/ dharmā ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pa mi dgos/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri pā ra ar+gham̐ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang /

mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing 'don don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ras bris la brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing ras bris la me tog gtor/ de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang / 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gis/ /thog med nas bsags tshe thung gyur pa yi/ /las sgrib ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la rtag 'god phyir/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /nad dang gnod med dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas bsam don kun 'grub shog /de ltar 'chi med dpal la longs spyod cing / /bdag cag rnams kyi spyod lam phra mo tshun/ /ma lus bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gyur nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pas don gnyis lhun grub shog /pha rol phyin dang bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud sde'i don la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas/

/rtse gcig theg mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyis/ /dpe yi ye shes tshe 'dir 'char bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gi dad pa'i shugs dang chos kyi dbyings/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces pas smon lam btab/ dril bu gsil zhing / rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang / 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang / lo brgya 'tsho zhing sogs dang / 'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos sogs dang / nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod cing rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /de dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i sgrub pa'i thabs ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ deng sang gangs can ljongs 'di'i skye bo rnams/ /tshe dang rigs brgyud dpal 'byor kun 'dzoms pa/ /re re tsam ste brgya la srid pa tsam/ /lhag par tshe mthar phyin pa ches dkon pa/ /mthong bas de dag rnams la phan phyir dang / /rang nyid bstan 'gro'i don mang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir nad med tshe ring ldan gyur cig /kye ma deng dus chos par rlom pa rnams/ /phal cher 'di snang kho na a 'thas kyis/ /phyi ma brjed nas byol song bzhin du 'chi/ /de phyir bdag gi yid smon 'di ltar gyur/ /g.yeng med chos mthun mthun rkyen la spyod cing / /mi tshe 'chad nyan sgrub la dril snyam yang / /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /khur 'dis g.yeng bar gyur mod de lta na'ang / /phyi ltar 'phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa spel/ /nang du zab mo'i lam la gcig tu dril/ /gdung brgyud rgyun mi chad pas skyong gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter mnga' zhing /

/bka' srung rnams kyi mthu rtsal bsam las 'das/ /bdag kyang lhag bsam dag pa'i nus mthu yis/ /bsam don ma lus 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i bsgrub pa'i thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di ni 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam 'phrul kun dga'i mtshan can/ rjes nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa la sogs te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gzhan thams cad 'chi med kyi dpal la spyod cing / bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ grub chen dze tā ri'i rgya gzhung dang / 'di'i bsgrub dkyil gyi yig cha sro lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab la brten nas/ me mo yos kyi lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la shab sgo lnga'i yul ljongs khyad par can dge sdings bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi/ bdag gi bla ma grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gzim chung gi mdo/ nyi 'od 'khyil par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba de nyid kyis bgyis so/

/'di brtsams dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /bstan 'gro'i don mang rgya cher bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lo brgya lhan cig 'tsho zhing gnas pa dang / /bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /'dis sems can dpag tu med pa la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig /sarba pa twe bh+yaḥshrī bhu ti puṇ+ya puṣ+ṭiṃ tsa/ sems can thams cad kyi dpal 'byor bsod nams rgyas pa dang / mā ra pa ti mā ra se nā bi wā ya bhā wan+tu/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig shā sa na sa twam̐ hi to ghā wan+tu/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig ka l+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 24 a myes zhabs/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
